title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
title_zh: NoeVera：知识能否指导实验，实验又能否完善知识？
abstract_en: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.
abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）服务需求增长，系统优化的难点已不只是预测某个配置的表现，而是判断哪些机制会影响当前负载、哪些配置值得测试，以及决策还缺什么证据。NoeVera 是一个智能体式第二大脑（Second Brain），将论文、代码、基准测试和实验结果组织为可追溯来源的持久知识库，分为原始证据、可复用综合结论和智能体记忆三层。系统按当前决策检索并组装精简证据包，由不同角色的智能体推理；需要量化验证时调用 Vidur 或 GAUSS 模拟器，并将发现连同适用范围写回知识库。在四种服务场景的配置搜索中，NoeVera 用中位数 6–7 次模拟调用即可将结果与最优值的差距缩小到 5% 以内，而贝叶斯优化和使用相同工具但不依赖知识库的智能体分别需要 9 次和 15 次。在 A100 GPU 上，其代表性配置达到 vLLM 默认配置约 1.30 倍的吞吐量，并满足所有场景的延迟目标。复用证据时，NoeVera 在考验结论适用范围的案例中仅有 8% 出现过度泛化，通用智能体记忆则为 28%。在一个含 72 项任务的基准中，NoeVera 在留出的 48 项任务上得分为 0.80，高于同等工具配备的智能体（0.62）和仅检索一次的版本（0.59）；即使向基线提供 NoeVera 的提示词，证据迭代带来的部分优势仍具有统计显著性。
key_points_zh: NoeVera 按决策需求检索证据，调用 Vidur 或 GAUSS 验证关键判断，再将结论及其适用范围写回知识库。
四种服务场景中，找到距最优值不超过 5% 的配置只需中位数 6–7 次模拟调用，少于贝叶斯优化的 9 次和无知识库智能体的 15 次。
在 A100 GPU 上，代表性配置达到 vLLM 默认配置约 1.30 倍的吞吐量，同时满足所有场景的延迟目标。
复用证据时，过度泛化率为 8%，低于通用智能体记忆的 28%。
在 48 项留出任务上得分 0.80，高于同等工具配备的智能体（0.62）和单次检索版本（0.59）；共享提示词后，证据迭代的部分优势仍显著。

agent-memory.reason: 系统将实验经验持久化为带来源和适用条件的外部证据，后续查询按完全匹配、部分匹配或不匹配决定复用、提示限制或拒用。错配陷阱对照量化了过度泛化，查询流评估量化了仿真调用节省。名为 Agent Memory Plane 的诊断层不参与推理检索；实际影响后续行为的是证据写回机制。
